"''What?|Faiza and Kleya Marki|audio=Faiza-Marki-What-MIS.flac|}} '''Faiza''' was an [[Faiza's species|alien]] [[Gender|female]] who was a patient of [[Lina Soh Hospital]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] in [[1 BBY]]. While [[Infiltration of Lina Soh Hospital|infiltrating]] the [[Medcenter|hospital]] to reach her [[Prisoner|captive]] ally [[Luthen Rael]], the [[Axis network|rebel]] [[Kleya Marki]] began pushing Faiza through the hospital in a [[med-glide wheelchair]] as part of a disguise as a [[nurse]]. Faiza was surprised by Marki interacting with her but did not object and generally seemed happy for a change of scenery. Marki took the patient up to the seventeenth floor on a [[turbolift]], but when an [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Unidentified ISB sentry|sentry]] informed her that access to higher floors was restricted, Marki left Faiza happily staring out a window while she continued to her target. ==Biography== ===Going for a ride=== {{Quote|I'll just be a moment. Someone will be right here with you.|A nurse leaves Faiza in a hospital corridor|audio=Nurse-RightHere-MIS.flac|}} [[File:Faiza-Kleya-MIS.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=A determined Kleya Marki, disguised as a nurse, pushes the elderly alien Faiza in a med-glide wheelchair through a stark white corridor of Lina Soh Hosptial.|Kleya Marki used Faiza to infiltrate Lina Soh Hospital.]] Faiza was an [[Faiza's species|alien]] [[Gender|female]] who was of advanced age by [[1 BBY]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. That [[Standard year|year]], she was a patient at [[Lina Soh Hospital]] on the [[planet]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' [[Coruscant]], where her caretakers lovingly nicknamed her "Granny." [[Unidentified nurse (Faiza)|One]] of the caretakers at one point left her sat in a [[med-glide wheelchair]] in a corridor on one of the [[Medcenter|hospital's]] upper floors, promising that she{{Andor|Make It Stop}} {{AD|Disney+}} would only be gone a moment and that someone would be with Faiza shortly. Instead, [[Kleya Marki]], a member of the rebel [[Axis network]] disguised as a [[nurse]], almost immediately began pushing Faiza's [[Repulsorlift chair|chair]] down the corridor. Faiza turned in surprise to look at Marki but did not object. The rebel was [[Infiltration of Lina Soh Hospital|infiltrating]] the hospital to reach the network's leader, [[Luthen Rael]], who had been wounded and [[Raid on the Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest|captured]] by the Empire and [[Prison|imprisoned]] in the hospital on the nineteenth floor. In order to reach him, she took Faiza onto a [[turbolift]] and began ascending. During the silent ride up, Faiza suddenly blurted out "eh?" in response to nothing, but when a confused Marki asked the patient what she was saying, the [[alien]] did not respond. ===Just happy to be here=== {{Quote|Seventeen's as far as you go.''"
"''We're trying to get to the 19th floor.''"
"''No. It's special access only at the moment.''"
"''Her daughter's up there.''"
"''Sorry, love.''"
"''We'll check in down here, then. Let them know.|An Imperial Security Bureau sentry and Kleya Marki|audio=Sentry-Marki-MIS.flac|}} [[File:Faiza-Kleya-Sentry-MIS.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=A disguised Kleya Marki stand behind a med-glide wheelchair in which Faiza sits, both of them looking at an armored Imperial Security Bureau sentry in a white-walled room at the Lina Soh Hospital.|Marki abandoned Faiza after a sentry halted their progress.]] The lift stopped at the seventeenth floor and, when Marki and Faiza exited, they were greeted by an [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Unidentified ISB sentry|sentry]] who informed them that they could go no higher, as the nineteenth floor, where Rael was being held, had been locked down to special access only. Marki claimed that they were trying to visit Faiza's daughter on that floor, but when the sentry refused to budge, she spoke loudly to a mumbling Faiza and told her they would check in on seventeen instead. Marki then wheeled the elderly alien away from the sentry and left Faiza in her med-glide on the seventeenth floor. There, the alien stared out a window, [[Music|scatting]] quietly to herself as she happily swung her hooved [[Limb|feet]] while they dangled from the chair. Marki, meanwhile, snuck onto the nineteenth floor, where she created a distraction by detonating explosives in several Imperial vehicles outside the hospital. She then [[Death|killed]] several Imperials to reach Rael, who was on [[life support]], which she fatally deactivated in order to spare him from being interrogated by the Empire. The rebel then escaped, after which the entire hospital was placed on lockdown by the Empire, with no one allowed in or out. Members of the Imperial Security Bureau later reviewed security footage from the hospital that showed Faiza with Marki.{{Andor|Who Else Knows?}} ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Huh?|Faiza reacts to encountering Kleya Marki|audio=Faiza-Huh-MIS.flac|}} Due to her advanced age, Faiza seemed simply glad to have a change of scenery when Marki moved her around the hospital. She had [[Color|black]] [[eye]]s and brown skin. ==Equipment== While in the hospital, Faiza wore a gray [[Clothing|medical gown]] and robe and was sat in a wheelchair. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|I have one question that I was left with at the end of that episode. Granny Faiza, the elderly alien in a wheelchair — is she okay?''"
"''In my script, I had Kleya putting her in a closet and closing the door and walking away. So, I was even rougher on old Granny. But I think she's okay. After the excitement of the assassination that went on on the floor above her, I think she was probably whisked out of there by her loving family. And she's sipping tea and scatting away into the night.|Interviewer Matt Gross and Tom Bissell|{{WebCite|url=https://www.inverse.com/entertainment/andor-writer-interview-wheel-of-fate-easter-eggs?fbclid=IwY2xjawKtvsVleHRuA2FlbQIxMABicmlkETFqdkFIYWc4bUR5OXFQVFNVAR5YIGOg-A2TbydEJG5fCKvmlV5Swao6duSOlBD0m8upExNuNL8GqCsi_NrvfQ_aem__s5mqqyRHeLhdsFDO0h6Ow|text=''Andor''{{'s}} Writer Offers A Different Perspective On The Wheel of Fate|author=Gross, Matt|date=2025-05-31|work=[[Wikipedia:Inverse (website)|''Inverse'']]|archivedate=20250605001046}}}} [[File:Faiza-BtS.jpg|thumb|right|300px|alt=A behind-the-scenes photograph of Faiza sitting on a chair with a green base.|Faiza was based on a design by Ivan Manzella.]] Faiza first appeared in "[[Make It Stop]]," the tenth episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']], which aired on [[May 13]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} The character was not identified in the episode but received a name in an entry in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] the [[May 14|following day]]. Faiza's design was created by [[Ivan Manzella]]{{Instagram|username=timatronics|url=p/DJwcPhYKwPU|name=[[Tim Berry]]|date=2025-05-17|quote=When we get to be involved with these amazing creatures for Star Wars, we don’t really know how much screen time they’ll get until it’s seen. This is a great example of this creature that was originally made for a quick shot in season one but was fortunate to get a lot more screen time in season 2 - the space granny. I over saw the animatronics for this creature which was one of 3 made originally for season one from a design by Ivan Manzella. Movement wise it was quite basic with eye blinks and gross mouth moment including a slew which frankly I love so much I try and put into any creature I mech. The palette of the mouth is soft so we could make it gurn and smoosh when closing the mouth. It also had a large double brow mech to add to the gross overall movement. All said, from quite a basic mech you get a nice character out of it. The neck was originally designed and built by Gerard Moore and the swaying feet made by Giles Hannagan. Puppeteered for season 2 by Lynn Robertson Bruce and Wim Oppenheimer. A pair of amazing puppeteers who really brought this character to life. Picture shown - property of Lucasfilm. #starwars #andor #andorseason2 #starwarscreatures #animatronics #spacegranny|archiveurl=https://archive.is/Rdmrf|archivefile=File:TimBerry-FaizaPart1-Instagram.png |archivefile2=File:TimBerry-FaizaPart2-Instagram.png|archivefile3=File:TimBerry-FaizaPart3-Instagram.png}} and was first used in "[[Announcement]],"{{Andor|Announcement}} the seventh episode of ''Andor's'' [[Andor Season 1|first season]], which aired on [[October 19]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-08-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}} [[Gerard Moore]] designed and built the neck for this original design and [[Giles Hannagan]] created the swaying feet while animatronic designer [[Tim Berry]] designed the animatronics of the heads. Berry discussed the trio with Manzella and they decided to keep the animatronics simple but expressive, using big mouth movements with a soft palette and teeth to "cheat" the movement through the simple mechanics of scrunching up the face.{{WookCite|url=p/4400000000003961302|text=Interview with Tim Berry|forum=1}} The member of the trio from season one with the most face and body movement was chosen to become Faiza, dubbed "space granny" during production, and the design was fleshed out for the second season, adding animatronics for blinking eyes and mouth movement including a special set-up for a particular [[Wikipedia:Gurn|gurn]] look when Faiza's mouth was closing.{{BookCite|author=Failes, Ian|title=befores & aftersnumber=#33|date=2025-06-17|pages=60|isbn=979-8287898458|link=https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FDKBM53C}} Berry oversaw Faiza's animatronics again, and the character was puppeteered by [[Lynn Robertson Bruce]] and [[Wim Oppenheimer]], with Oppenheimer also providing Faiza's voice.{{Instagram|username=claireroiharvey|url=p/DJwcPhYKwPU/c/18069230554945382|name=[[Claire Roi Harvey]]|date=2025-05-17|quote=Such great work Tim! Thrilled that one of the grannies got a full moment in the limelight- and what a scene…!!!! Really brilliant that they kept @wimoppenheimer s vocal performance in there too. 🔥👏|archiveurl=https://archive.is/Rdmrf|archivefile=File:TimBerry-FaizaPart3-Instagram.png}} The character's chair had a hole in it to allow one of the puppeteers to operate her neck from behind while the other operated the face via remote control. According to Berry, the animatronics for Faiza were fairly basic, but the soft mouth palette allowed for gurning and smooshing when the mouth closed, something that Berry enjoys and tries to include in any creatures he controls. The alien's mechanical large double brow also added to this effect, which Berry considered gross. [[Tom Bissell]], who wrote the episodes in which Faiza appeared, originally had Marki leaving the elderly alien shut in a closet in the script, but in an interview with Matt Gross of [[Wikipedia:Inverse (website)|''Inverse'']] on [[May 31]], 2025, he speculated that Faiza was safe following the hospital lockdown and likely whisked away by her loving family after all the excitement. He then joked that Faiza should have appeared, still just kicking her feet in her chair, during the montage in "[[Jedha, Kyber, Erso]]"{{Andor|Jedha, Kyber, Erso}}—the season's final episode, which also aired on May 13, 2025—that showed the final fate of each of the major characters, called "The Wheel of Fate," during production. ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Faiza|imagecat=Images of Faiza}} *{{Andor|Make It Stop}} {{1st}} *{{Andor|Who Else Knows?}} {{C|Appears on screen}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/andor-trivia-guide-week-4|text=Secrets from the Set of ''Andor'' Season 2: Week 4 Trivia}} *{{Databank|faiza-granny|Faiza (“Granny”)}} {{1stID|Faiza}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=ფეიზა }} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Individuals of unidentified species]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]]
